body: apps/desktop sidebar resizer (renderer/src/SidebarResizer.tsx) ported from chrome-ext SidebarResizer.tsx: 1px hairline, 2px invisible hit zone, pointer-events drag (window-level listeners during drag, removed on pointerup), clamped 180-560px, double-click resets to 256 default. Width lives in UIPrefs.sidebarWidth (persisted to lib:ui alongside sidebar/toc/fullscreen/readingMode/raw). Aside drops Tailwind w-64 in favor of inline style.width. Build + tsc + offscreen verified.
